sentences.jp: 義母は袖で目元を押さえ、肩を小さく揺らした。

sentences.en: In terms of the Iemori executive, there was no one better at reading the timing than him, and Isshin couldn't help but smile wryly to himself.

sentences.jp: 長年連れ添った腹心は、主の沈黙の意味を、いつも正しく汲み取ってくれる。

sentences.en: The loyal confidant who has been by my side for many years always understands the meaning of my silence correctly.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.jp: 「食べるものには、気を使ってくださいね」
sentences.ruby: 「食べるものには、気を使ってくださいね」
sentences.en: "Please be mindful of what you eat."

sentences.en: The long silence that flowed between mother and daughter slightly eased the tense atmosphere of the tatami room.

sentences.en: And said.

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.en: As I stepped out into the hallway, the night air felt cold against my cheeks.

sentences.en: Tomorrow, the name I will call myself is one that my father never once used.

sentences.jp: それでも父は、きっとどこかで聞いていてくれるだろうと、一心は信じることにした。
